quote: Minoru uses his move Grape Rush (which involves throwing the sticky substance from his head at the opponent while running towards them); Minoru's move hits Midnight, causing Midnight to become stuck in place which allows Minoru to run past her.
Minoru is one who always speaks his mind, even when it comes off as harsh and insulting due to his comments being more on the cynical side.

Minoru is shown to be slightly jealous of Izuku gaining affection from females. This was first shown when Hanta made the claim that Camie Utsushimi (who was actually Himiko Toga in disguise) was hiding with Izuku while naked, with Minoru specifically screaming and assuming he crossed 'several bases' with her at that time.

Mina convinced a dispirited Minoru (who couldn't reach the guitar strings due to his small size) to take part by promising him a harem part in the performance, this caused Minoru to quickly come around while in joy and Mina later made good on her promise.
Minoru has a huge jealous streak, often envying those who are seen as cool and attract female attention, while lamenting how seemingly simple and underpowered his Quirk is compared to his classmates.

Even despite being unable to stand up, Minoru weakly throws one of his Pop Off balls at All For One's leg, getting his attention. He tells him not to steal Dark Shadow or else he'll become an edgelord, and that he should steal his Quirk instead as he'll get a cool hairdo out of it, begging him not to take it from Fumikage.
Minoru was the most desperate to comfort him when he broke down into tears, running up to him before being stopped by Tenya and then running up to him later alongside Kota to hug him.
